immutableBaseline.rule: Do not mutate, rename, replace, or relabel baseline S2/S3 artifacts. The baseline S3 graph remains experimental evidence.

knownS2Limits: Poppler emission order is not semantic reading order

structuralPrimitiveContract.pagePartition: A same-page structural class supported by named header-anchor observations; not a semantic candidate.
structuralPrimitiveContract.headerAnchorGroup: A set of raw word/line observations whose geometry forms one local header band. Its members and bounding union are retained.
structuralPrimitiveContract.columnPattern: A repeated set of source-observed x-ranges inside a named header/row band; it is evidence, not a table cell model.
structuralPrimitiveContract.boundedStructuralGroup: A same-page union of constituent observation bboxes with explicit member observation IDs. Its inferred bounding box never asserts a PDF-drawn frame.
structuralPrimitiveContract.localUnitAnchor: A raw unit declaration retained as a source observation; it scopes only an explicitly supported boundedStructuralGroup.
structuralPrimitiveContract.ambiguousStructuralGroup: A group with partial source support that must not be promoted to outer ledger, remarks, local table, semantic candidate, or financial owner.

requirements: On one page, form raw-glyph header groups for 要求+番号, 事+項, 前+年+度+予+算+額, 概+算+要+求+額, and 備+考.

Each group must be in one local header band, defined by overlapping/touching line bboxes using that page's maximum observed line height as its tolerance; no global pixel or percentage threshold is allowed.
The groups must be ordered left-to-right by their geometry and retain their constituent observation IDs and union bboxes.
At least two source-observed row bands below the header must repeat two or more header x-ranges. The evidence is the concrete rows/observations, not page-wide token presence.
The result is outerLedger only when all requirements hold. Otherwise emit unclassifiedStructure or ambiguousStructuralGroup, never a guessed outer ledger.
Build a candidate only from a same-page, contiguous source-order/geometry group with its own header-anchor group and at least two repeated x-cluster row bands.

A02 boundedLocalTable additionally requires a raw （単位：百万円） localUnitAnchor in the candidate group plus a local multi-column header group. Right-side location, unit co-occurrence, and proximity to outer ledger are each insufficient alone.
A01 may create nestedStructure only where the group independently meets the header-plus-repeated-pattern rule. Otherwise retain ambiguousStructuralGroup with its direct observations.
Do not infer PDF frame lines, cell boundaries, outer-to-local containment, or parent financial ownership from the inferred bbox.

Place outerLedger and boundedLocalTable/nestedStructure as separate page-contained grammar partitions. Do not create an embedded_in edge between them unless direct S2 evidence supports that exact relationship.
nestedOrLocal.unitScope: A localUnitAnchor contextualizes only its own boundedLocalTable. Outer 千円 and local 百万円 have no inheritance edge between them; missing sufficient support yields ambiguity rather than a unit assignment.

evidenceClosure.membershipRule: Every inferred membership/containment edge lists the direct child observation IDs and the direct parent anchor/group observations that caused it. Broad page-line lists and empty supportingObservationIds are invalid.
evidenceClosure.stateRule: state remains an observation-state field where applicable. Structural certainty is carried separately in ambiguityState and structuralStatus; state: observed_value never means structurally inferred.
evidenceClosure.referenceRule: All supportingObservationIds must resolve in immutable source-observations.jsonl. Each locator contains source-order paths and raw geometry/bbox references sufficient to re-evaluate the rule.

manifestSeparation.S2: Contains source/acquisition/extraction facts, raw-artifact hashes, coverage, and S2 statistics only.
manifestSeparation.S3: Contains partitions, inferred-structure counts, ambiguity summaries, rule/profile versions, and structural diagnostics.
manifestSeparation.crossStage: If retained, cross-stage run metadata is separately labeled and cannot make an S2 manifest assert an S3 conclusion.

requirements: no timestamps, hostnames, or worktree paths
